lockUser: SELECT user_id FROM n_users WHERE user_id = :user_id FOR UPDATE
activeTarget: SELECT user_id FROM v_user_profile_public WHERE user_id = :target_id AND is_active = 1
block:
MERGE INTO n_user_blocks b USING (SELECT :actor_id AS actor_id, :target_id AS target_id FROM dual) src
ON (b.user_id = src.actor_id AND b.target_user_id = src.target_id)
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id, target_user_id) VALUES (src.actor_id, src.target_id)
cancelFollows:
UPDATE n_user_follows SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE status = 'active' AND ((follower_id = :actor_id AND following_id = :target_id)
OR (follower_id = :target_id AND following_id = :actor_id))
unblock: DELETE FROM n_user_blocks WHERE user_id = :actor_id AND target_user_id = :target_id
mute:
MERGE INTO n_user_mutes m USING (SELECT :actor_id AS actor_id, :target_id AS target_id, CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(:expires_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3TZH:TZM') AT LOCAL AS TIMESTAMP) AS expires_at FROM dual) src
ON (m.user_id = src.actor_id AND m.target_user_id = src.target_id)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET expires_at = src.expires_at
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (user_id, target_user_id, expires_at) VALUES (src.actor_id, src.target_id, src.expires_at)
unmute: DELETE FROM n_user_mutes WHERE user_id = :actor_id AND target_user_id = :target_id
blocks:
WITH visible AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, u.display_name, u.bio, u.location, u.website,
         u.is_verified, u.followers_count, u.following_count, u.posts_count, u.likes_count,
         u.created_at, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(32)) AS expires_at
  FROM n_user_blocks rel
  JOIN v_user_profile_public u ON u.user_id = rel.target_user_id AND u.is_active = 1
  WHERE rel.user_id = :viewer_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT visible.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY followers_count DESC, created_at DESC, user_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM visible
)
SELECT COALESCE(r.user_id, 0) AS user_id, r.username, r.avatar_url, r.display_name, r.bio, r.location, r.website,
       r.is_verified, r.followers_count, r.following_count, r.posts_count, r.likes_count,
       'offline' AS online_status, NULL AS last_seen_at,
       CASE WHEN r.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN fn_get_user_relationship(:viewer_id, r.user_id) END AS relation,
       r.expires_at, t.total
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM visible) t
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.rn BETWEEN :start_row AND :end_row
ORDER BY r.rn
mutes:
WITH visible AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, u.display_name, u.bio, u.location, u.website,
         u.is_verified, u.followers_count, u.following_count, u.posts_count, u.likes_count,
         u.created_at, TO_CHAR(FROM_TZ(rel.expires_at, SESSIONTIMEZONE) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.FF3"Z"') AS expires_at
  FROM n_user_mutes rel
  JOIN v_user_profile_public u ON u.user_id = rel.target_user_id AND u.is_active = 1
  WHERE rel.user_id = :viewer_id AND (rel.expires_at IS NULL OR rel.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
), ranked AS (
  SELECT visible.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY followers_count DESC, created_at DESC, user_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM visible
)
SELECT COALESCE(r.user_id, 0) AS user_id, r.username, r.avatar_url, r.display_name, r.bio, r.location, r.website,
       r.is_verified, r.followers_count, r.following_count, r.posts_count, r.likes_count,
       'offline' AS online_status, NULL AS last_seen_at,
       CASE WHEN r.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN fn_get_user_relationship(:viewer_id, r.user_id) END AS relation,
       r.expires_at, t.total
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM visible) t
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.rn BETWEEN :start_row AND :end_row
ORDER BY r.rn
blocked: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM n_user_blocks b WHERE ((b.user_id = :actor_id AND b.target_user_id = :target_id) OR (b.user_id = :target_id AND b.target_user_id = :actor_id))
follow:
MERGE INTO n_user_follows f USING (SELECT :actor_id AS actor_id, :target_id AS target_id FROM dual) src
ON (f.follower_id = src.actor_id AND f.following_id = src.target_id)
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET status = 'active', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE f.status = 'cancelled'
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (follower_id, following_id, status) VALUES (src.actor_id, src.target_id, 'active')
unfollow:
UPDATE n_user_follows SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE follower_id = :actor_id AND following_id = :target_id AND status = 'active'
followCount: SELECT followers_count FROM n_user_stats WHERE user_id = :target_id
followActor: SELECT COALESCE(display_name, username) AS name FROM n_users WHERE user_id = :actor_id
followers:
WITH visible AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, u.display_name, u.bio, u.location, u.website,
         u.is_verified, u.followers_count, u.following_count, u.posts_count, u.likes_count,
         u.created_at, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(32)) AS expires_at
  FROM (SELECT follower_id AS user_id FROM n_user_follows WHERE following_id = :target_id AND status = 'active') rel
  JOIN v_user_profile_public u ON u.user_id = rel.user_id AND u.is_active = 1
  JOIN n_users target_user ON target_user.user_id = :target_id AND target_user.is_active = 1
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b WHERE ((b.user_id = :viewer_id AND b.target_user_id = :target_id) OR (b.user_id = :target_id AND b.target_user_id = :viewer_id))
    OR ((b.user_id = :viewer_id AND b.target_user_id = u.user_id) OR (b.user_id = u.user_id AND b.target_user_id = :viewer_id)) OR ((b.user_id = :target_id AND b.target_user_id = u.user_id) OR (b.user_id = u.user_id AND b.target_user_id = :target_id)))
), ranked AS (
  SELECT visible.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY followers_count DESC, created_at DESC, user_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM visible
)

mutual-following:
WITH visible AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, u.display_name, u.bio, u.location, u.website,
         u.is_verified, u.followers_count, u.following_count, u.posts_count, u.likes_count,
         u.created_at, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(32)) AS expires_at
  FROM (SELECT f.following_id AS user_id FROM n_user_follows f JOIN n_user_follows v ON v.following_id = f.following_id AND v.follower_id = :viewer_id AND v.status = 'active' WHERE f.follower_id = :target_id AND f.status = 'active') rel
  JOIN v_user_profile_public u ON u.user_id = rel.user_id AND u.is_active = 1
  JOIN n_users target_user ON target_user.user_id = :target_id AND target_user.is_active = 1

    OR ((b.user_id = :viewer_id AND b.target_user_id = u.user_id) OR (b.user_id = u.user_id AND b.target_user_id = :viewer_id)) OR ((b.user_id = :target_id AND b.target_user_id = u.user_id) OR (b.user_id = u.user_id AND b.target_user_id = :target_id)))
